title: Sailing with dolphins
text:
We were sailing through the natural park of the cliffs of Maro-Cerro Gordo, with magnificent views and were lucky enough to see many dolphins.
One pass!!
author: AlbertoA2003

title: Spectacular day on a sailboat
text:
Wonderful family day sailing on a very beautiful sailboat.
Captain Alberto was very kind to the whole family and we really enjoyed his company.
We stopped to swim in a beautiful cove and practice paddle surfing and snorkeling.
We also saw dolphins and the children loved that.
In short, an unforgettable experience and totally recommended.
Thank you
author: basilioa435
